segments.t: Max has brought Nastya and Kostya to Vika's flat as a birthday surprise, and it is a mistake. Vika expected a quiet evening for two, and Nastya was told that Vika wouldn't be there. Listen to it fall apart in Russian first.
Как может меня не быть дома?
Я хотел отметить день рождения вместе.
Now let's replay the evening, line by line.
'Hello.' "Zdraste" is the quick spoken form of "zdravstvuyte", and it's what you'll actually hear.
'Is this your party?' "Vecherinka", party, comes from "vecher", evening.
'You said she wouldn't be here.' "Eyo ne budet" is literally "of her there won't be", the Russian way to say someone will be absent.
Как может меня не быть дома?
'How can I not be at home?' "Menya ne byt" follows the same pattern as "eyo ne budet". "Doma" means at home.
'Why did you bring them?' "Zachem" asks "what for?", about the purpose. "Privyol" means "brought along".
'Why didn't you warn us?' "Pochemu" asks about the reason, unlike "zachem". "Predupredil" means "warned".
'You'd never have come.' "By" turns "prishli", came, into "would have come". "Nikogda ne" means never.
'You're my friends.' "Vy moi druzya" needs no "are".
Я хотел отметить день рождения вместе.

'I wanted us to celebrate my birthday together.' Russians 'mark' a birthday: 'otmetit'' literally means 'to mark', and it's the usual verb for celebrating an occasion. 'Khotel', I wanted, is masculine past, because Max is speaking.
'You don't have to worry.' "Mozhete ne", you can not, is Russian for "you don't have to". "Volnovatsya" means to worry.
'Thanks for a lovely evening.' "Prekrasnyy" means lovely or beautiful, and here it's pure sarcasm.
'Bye.' Max's "poka" is the casual goodbye, said to all of them on his way out.
'Max, wait!' "Stoy", stop, comes from "stoyat" again, this time as a plea. Here's the whole evening again, start to finish.
Как может меня не быть дома?
Я хотел отметить день рождения вместе.
Max leaves in a huff, and Vika calls him back. When you hear "zachem", remember it asks "what for?", a different question from "pochemu", why. See you next time!

lines.fragment: Макс, это и есть твоя безбашенная вечеруха с бывшими одногруппниками?
Ты же говорил, что Вики, Виктория Сергеевна не будет.
Как может меня не быть у меня дома?
Ты почему меня не предупредил? И нас.
Если бы я вас предупредил, вы никогда бы в жизни не собрались.
Это моя девушка, вы мои друзья.
Я хотел, чтобы мой день рождения мы отметили вместе.
Но если для вас это такая проблема, можете не париться.
